label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. E1 records a past accident inside the area and, under the national criteria, is a clearance target after the first NTS visit; technical survey is unavailable in this programme. E2–E4 provide substantial safe-use evidence, but do not override the required intrusive follow-up for the accident record.
flags: E1 has no date or other detail, and its location has not been checked on the ground.
Three first-hand users report safe use for 11–21 years; this evidence should remain visible in the sign-off review.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: The database record is an unchecked historical record with no date or ground-checked location, so it suggests possible EO but does not confirm it; its reliability is unassessed.

E2.quote: We have hunted and fished along these streams for 11 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E2.note: The informant reports 11 years of firsthand land use without finding EO or an accident, supporting absence; the source is a first-hand user.

E3.quote: We have walked the trail across this land to the school for 21 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E3.note: The informant reports 21 years of firsthand use crossing the area without finding EO or an accident, supporting absence; the source is a first-hand user.

E4.quote: A woodcutter said he has cut firewood and timber in the area every year for the past 11 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E4.note: The woodcutter reports repeated firsthand use over 11 years without finding EO or hearing of an accident, supporting absence; the source is a first-hand user.
